list.title: Sensors
list.description: Overview of all sensors registered in the system. You can add new sensors by scanning the QR code on the sensor unit.
list.emptyPreparedMessage: There are no prepared sensors. New devices appear here once they are registered and waiting to be activated.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by EUI, model or location

kpi.batteryShutoffInfo: The battery switches off below 2.8 V.
kpi.receptionInfo: RSSI of the last transmission. Higher (less negative) means better reception.

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.discardedSummary_one: One reading was discarded in the last seven days.
dataQuality.discardedSummary_other: {count} readings were discarded in the last seven days.
dataQuality.acknowledgeDialogDescription: The previously discarded readings are then considered reviewed. If implausible values occur again, the sensor will flag them again on its own.
dataQuality.acknowledgeNotePlaceholder: Reason, e.g. probe was not connected during setup
dataQuality.acknowledgeFailedToast: The note could not be saved.

signalChart.subtitle: Higher (less negative) = better reception
signalChart.tooFewDataPoints: Not enough data points in the selected period.

placement.title: Placement
placement.noTargetDescription: This sensor is not linked yet. Without a link, its readings cannot be attributed.

location.derivedFromTargetNotice: The position is taken from the linked object.

lorawanConfig.title: Advanced LoRaWAN configuration
lorawanConfig.secretsWarningDescription: LoRaWAN keys (APPKEY, APPSKEY, NWKSKEY, PWORD) are hidden by default and can be revealed individually. They are automatically redacted when copied.

actions.deleteConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone. Sensor {id} will be permanently removed, including its LoRaWAN configuration and all readings.
actions.deleteFailedToast: The sensor could not be deleted.
actions.transferBlockedBound: Moves along with the object it is linked to.
actions.transferDialogDescription: The sensor moves to the chosen organization. It can then be linked to a target there.
actions.transferFailedToast: The sensor could not be moved.
actions.removeConfirmDescription: The link will be removed and the sensor reset to the "{status}" state. It can then be activated again like a new sensor.

header.title: Scan sensor QR code
header.description: Hold the QR code on the sensor unit steady inside the scan frame. This uniquely identifies the sensor before you assign it in the next step. In poor lighting, it helps to hold the code a little closer.

checking.title: Checking sensor
checking.description: We're matching the scanned ID against the database. This only takes a moment.

notFound.title: Sensor not found
notFound.description: This sensor ID is not registered in the system.
notFound.hint: Make sure the sensor unit was registered in the system through administration, or contact the admin.

badRequest.title: Invalid sensor ID
badRequest.description: The scanned ID does not match the expected format.
badRequest.hint: Please check that you scanned the correct QR code on the sensor unit.

network.title: Matching failed
network.description: Matching against the database could not be performed.
network.hint: Please check your internet connection and try again.

notActivatable.title: Sensor cannot be activated
notActivatable.onlineDescription: This sensor is already activated and linked.
notActivatable.offlineDescription: This sensor has already been activated and is currently offline.

recognized.title: Sensor recognized
recognized.description: Known in the system and cleared for activation.

header.title: Review assignment
header.description: Confirm sensor, assignment and location. The link is saved once you select "Activate sensor".

chooseKind.title: Choose assignment
chooseKind.description: Choose what you are mounting the sensor on.

target.noKinds: No active module offers targets for sensors.
